scope: Eight packaged Windows Vulkan Forward+ 1280x720 offline processes at 60 fps. The observer uses the normal campaign picker and a right-click move. Results describe callback intervals, not exclusive CPU or GPU time.

conditions.fast: Click the sortie as soon as the ordinary menu gate and card are visible.
conditions.steady: Wait until the eight synthesized tracks are ready and another 0.5 seconds before opening the picker.
conditions.cache: Same host and shared filesystem cache in sequential processes. Payload read for digest verification before and after each measurement.
